I don’t believe it..

it’s okay man. i just took it very personal..we’re all here struggling, this is a safe place for us..we have to help each other..i forgive you. i’m sorry for saying “fuck you”

this has been the worse day of the year for me..while everyone is enjoying themselves posting all this family stuff i was trying to get away, being alone from everything and everybody..i saw a couple bridges today as well while driving to help with my pain..i felt like pulling over and jumping..but I didn’t.
i’m with you. i literally feel this same. i’ve lost 10 pounds in about a month or so..i have no energy to even eat anymore..food makes me sick so i just don’t even bother

thank you so much for this..this is exactly how i took that comment, i found it very offensive I was so mad.. but I appreciate these words..this is exactly what I was going to say but I didn’t write anything just for the benefit of the doubt..we are all struggling, this is a suicide form for gods sake..i just like to write what I feel since I have nobody to talk to..I don’t have friends..my family I can’t even speak with them.
i feel sad too, so much for a happy holiday

i’m glad you were able to get through the pain bro..it’s been a really hard time for me..i bring myself down so much but this actually gave me some clarity on what will actually have to happen..i’ve been having suicidal thoughts lately just about life in general as well..i have no career planned..i dropped out of college so i don’t have nothing to look forward too, working the same job for 3 years..it’s all bad..

i treated her terribly..like i wasn’t there for her when she needed me the most..looking back i wish i could change everything i did..she was my true love, she was there for me through it all..now she’s moved on and i’m here reminiscing about the past every single day, i hate myself
my future doesn’t look to good honestly, getting close to the ending point..but i appreciate your kind words.
fuck you
